entry.name: trayIndicator
entry.label: How the tray icon shows whether the mouse mover is running: "dot-when-running", "dot-always", "icon-swap" or "none".

entry.name: direction
entry.label: Direction of the nudge: "right", "left", "up", "down" or "cycle" (a small square back to the start).

entry.name: stepPixels
entry.label: How far the pointer moves per nudge, in pixels (1-500).
